title: CCP: join rate limiting and PoW (2a.5.5.2) not implemented anywhere
description: NOT-IMPLEMENTED. Req: 'Nodes MUST implement join-attempt rate limiting' (2a.5.5.2): node <=1 join/10s; after 3 consecutive failed joins exponential backoff 20/40/80s max 320s, reset on success; root tracks per-IID sliding window, MUST ignore IIDs >6 req/60s; global 60 req/60s -> respond 5.03 + MAY enable PoW; dropped requests MUST NOT allocate state; per-IID table <=1024 entries with LRU eviction. OPTIONAL PoW: 8-byte pow_challenge in beacon CBOR options; joiner pow_response 4-byte with SHA-256(pow_challenge||joiner_iid||pow_response)[0:2]==0x0000; root MUST reject invalid/missing when challenge advertised. Evidence: rg pow_challenge|pow_response|join.*rate|backoff.*320 across python/src, rust/, lichen/ = zero production hits (only unrelated CoAP 5.03 peer backoff lichen-coap/src/client.rs:159-263, BroadcastRateLimiter, SOS ratelimit). Spec added by commit 380396613a. Suggested placement: python/src/lichen/timing/tdma_fsm.py (node backoff) + root join gate in gateway; rust/lichen-gateway (per-IID LRU table); C lichen/subsys/lichen/link/ (Kconfig-gated). Beacon CBOR pow_challenge field also needs the beacon codec work tracked by the beacon-format gap bead.
close_reason: Duplicate of project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.26 (join rate limiting/backoff/per-IID table, spec 02a 2a.5.5.2) filed by prior sweep; evidence consolidated in docs/spec-coverage/02a-coordinated-capacity.md
